rows.text: Hello... ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer]'s surprised expression is just like what the memories recorded.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Rather than "knowing" you, it might be better described as... I "remember" you...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Is this... a new way to chat someone up?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Well, I guess you did see the end of countless Cyrenes, in a way of speaking. But I'm standing before you right here, right now, as alive as ever. Isn't that a good thing?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Maybe I'm both? Just kidding. If I had to choose... Then I'm probably closer to the latter.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's pretty unbelievable for me too. It's like I had a long, long dream. Cyrene's memories... and Mem's memories... they're all tangled together. But when I woke up... there were only broken fragments left.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I can't remember what happened in those thirty million cycles, but I remember what you, [Trailblazer], did for this world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Like... Didn't you wish for me to turn into a pretty girl back at the Grove?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Then is this my wish coming true?
You remembered that? Please remember something good next time.
Wait. I didn't pick that option.
Yep. Isn't it amazing? It's like a seed finally grew up and became a flower! And I'm definitely as cute as a flower now.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hey. Everything about you is good, [Trailblazer]. That's why I'll remember all of it.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Huh? You didn't? Teehee~ In that case, just treat it as my own wish then!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: There's so much I want to say, but unfortunately... this isn't the time to reminisce.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: With the memories of the previous Flame-Chase still intact, we've returned to this place at the beginning of time, so we can carry out our promise to Phainon.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The descent of Irontomb may be looming over the horizon... but we still have a chance to change everything.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Who's she waiting for?
It was the same for Phainon...
Can you remember anything else?
I don't know... It sounds weird, doesn't it? It's something that happened to me, but I'm talking as if I'm an observer.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yes. Phainon, too, embarked on his journey because of this view... He then walked alone for more than thirty million cycles.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I don't think I can... It sounds weird, doesn't it? It's something that happened to me, but I'm talking as if I'm an observer.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Amphoreus will fall into an ending of "Destruction" after the next "Era Nova"...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Lygus is the primary culprit behind everything.
We must stop Irontomb's descent.
We need the help of more allies from beyond the sky.
That's right. He's the mastermind who's trying to control everything. How unforgivable.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I believe in your capacities. The hands of the Trailblaze can create miracles, and will certainly be able to snuff out the flames of evil.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: That's right. "Lygus" is the mastermind behind it, the one who's trying to control everything. How unforgivable.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's right. We now know that sealing off the sky wasn't Aquila's actual intention...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But I still feel a bit anxious... Lygus chose to walk into the spotlight and reveal everything, which means he still thinks the current situation is under his control.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Time to call Screwllum with the Chronocognitive Anchor...
Write his name in "As I've Written"...
Make a wish to the Stellaron to destroy Lygus...
...Nothing's gonna happen even if you write down his name, you know? Besides, this book is a cute fairytale. Please don't write stuff about the antagonist in it.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Wouldn't that... be a waste? Dan Heng specifically said not to let you use that power. Please don't take that risk.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Aedes Elysiae is a little village enclosed by Time. We might be able to contact the outside world from here.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Firstly, we need to find a well-hidden spot...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's super quiet here. Sounds can't get in or out.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Back in "Cyrene's" memories, this room was her secret base. No one noticed her practicing Oronyx's Prayer here or trying to speak with the gods in secret.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But today's different, isn't it? We aren't trying to contact unreachable gods, but humans from other worlds, real people.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'm prepared to witness that miracle, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: (The way Cyrene talks is so similar to Mem...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (I have so many questions... I'm also worried about how Dan Heng and March 7th are doing. Here's hoping the Chronocognitive Anchor can still function normally, because I really need answers...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Signal strength... 14.8%... Dialogue window... 16 minutes 22 seconds... Prerequisite: No external interferences..."
It's such a relief to see you two...
How are things outside this world?
Herta! You're here too?
Pity. Now's not the time to celebrate. Having two geniuses standing here means you are in big, BIG trouble.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Sorry, no good news. When two geniuses show up at once... you know you're in deep trouble.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Not only am I here, but I also happened to have saved you four times already... without you even being aware of it, of course.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But now's not the time to celebrate. When two geniuses show up at once... you know you're in deep trouble.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Listen up, little one. The Destruction's eyes are gazing upon this place. No, I'm not joking, and no, it's not Droidhead. It's the real Nanook.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Time is running out, so I'll explain in terms you understand: this world, Amphoreus, is in fact a testing ground where the Lord Ravager, Irontomb, evolves through self-extrapolation.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Hiding in this segmentum unknown to other lifeforms, it has endlessly repeated the process of "Era Nova," seeking a solution that could obliterate the Erudition.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: We are very glad to learn that you're safe, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: For some reason, the experiment entered a prolonged state of stagnation. However, it has now restarted.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Prediction: If effective intervention is not performed, Irontomb will complete its Self-Coronation in 14 system hours and initiate its plan to destroy the entire Path of Erudition.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Fourteen system hours is no time at all...!
How will it destroy the Erudition?
Hasn't Irontomb been around for a long time?

The possibilities are endless. Breaking down interstellar communications, destroying the Synesthesia Beacons, returning cosmic civilizations to the dark ages, or even starting the third Anti-Organic War... Any of it would be able to bring the cosmos to its knees.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Simply put, it will tilt all sciences and technologies towards the Destruction. And since Nanook glanced at this place, it means THEY are being dead serious.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Based on info provided by the IPC, Irontomb probably isn't like Celenova or Zephyro, who are Overlords ascended from human beings. Instead, Irontomb is an algorithmic sequence. It can be anywhere, as long as there is a receptacle for its calculation.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The version of Irontomb hiding in Amphoreus is its "source code." And this Scepter is its incubator.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Yep. Think of it as the program having reached 99.98% completion already... and then it's over.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Something in the shadows has been driving everything forward: It's the observer named "Lygus." Speculation: He's the Scepter system's Administrator.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: He wants Irontomb to break through the Knowledge Singularity. I don't know why he wants to do it, but he'll remove interferences at any cost. You're the only variable within his world, and you're the only thing he fears.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: So listen closely, little one. The speed of time is different in Amphoreus compared to the outside. Destruction is just about to arrive, but you can still play Deliverer one last time...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The cycles have already been broken. You've entered what is theoretically the last cycle Amphoreus will ever be able to run, and Irontomb will break out of its prison as soon as the process of "genesis" is triggered once more.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But now there's an abnormality within the experiment. You know what I'm talking about. One of the model's twelve factors — that is, one of the twelve demigods — destroyed himself using the power of the Destruction.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Phainon's signal disappeared from the cycles the moment Nanook cast THEIR gaze this way. That means Worldbearing's computational logic is currently flawed and bugged, yet it's the factor directly related to the process of "genesis."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Phainon sacrificed himself to create an opportunity for us.
He entrusted the duty of Worldbearing to me.
Phainon didn't die. He's still fighting.

That old Intellitron will definitely do all he can to debug this error, so you have to take this chance to claim Kephale's Coreflame. Don't let him have his way. The key to suppressing Irontomb lies in whether we can rewrite the purpose of "Era Nova."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: There's one more preparation we must make. Lygus's behavior has been quite abnormal. He's never interfered in the actions of Titans or the demigods throughout the whole experiment.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Deduction: The Scepter has an extremely strict autonomous protocol, restricting even its Administrator. In Amphoreus, this Ultimate Protocol goes by another name...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: The Law Titan, Talanton.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: "Law"... they are the rules that restrain all things in Amphoreus, and it was the Coreflame returned at the very beginning of the last Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Why do you have another little pink one next to you?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Huh? Her Path chart is...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Um... Is there something wrong with me...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Herta, the firewall's interference is getting closer. Time is running out, {M#Mister}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer]. Please ask any questions you still have as soon as possible.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Never mind. Let's get back to the topic at hand. "Light Calendar 3960, Month of Balance." We'll be locking onto this time period to find Law. You can either meet the Titan, convince the demigod, or take the Coreflame by force... It doesn't matter what you do, so long as you bend it to your favor.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: We still haven't figured out how you and Dan Heng got inside this world, so influencing protocol is currently our best way to stop Lygus or to call for more reinforcements into this fight. Once you've got Law in your hands, we'll discuss our next steps...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Make sure... the Coreflame... doesn't fall... into enemy... hands...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I don't have any other questions.
How's the Express Crew doing?
Is Dan Heng safe?
Where's March 7th?
Irontomb can't affect the real world just yet. Don't worry. Himeko and the others are more concerned about your well-being than their own.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Mr. Dan Heng did not enter the new world with you at the end of the last cycle. Known: The flow of time inside and outside Amphoreus is not identical. A thousand years in this world may only be a fleeting second outside of it.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Conclusion: He is on his way back to the Express.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Miss March's situation is rather complicated.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Madam Herta and I can detect her signal, but cannot ascertain her location. What we can be sure of is that she's still in Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Don't worry about her. She's absolutely chock-full of mysteries. Even if Amphoreus explodes, she'll probably float out perfectly protected in a nice thick layer of ice. Worry more about yourself instead.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I'm not gonna give any motivational speeches. I just hope you bring good news the next time we meet, little one.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: No, not "little one." "Deliverer."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Those two geniuses... certainly have memorable personalities.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What do you think about them?
Can you understand their explanations?
It feels weird... This all feels really familiar. Some of that conversation feels like it's about things I once knew, but then forgot.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yeah... I understand more than I should, actually. Honestly, some of that conversation feels like it's about things I once knew, but then forgot.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Maybe it's because of Mem? After all, Mem's a memosprite born out of your thoughts, [Trailblazer]. Maybe our memories somehow got tangled up together?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Never mind. Let's focus on something more important with what little time we have. Just treat me as an ordinary girl with secrets, okay?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Light Calendar 3960... I remember that Talanton had already fallen by then, and the Chrysos Heir who inherited that Coreflame is named "Cerydra." That's what's recorded in history and the period we'll be heading to. We'll need to find Law and stop Lygus...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: So we've at least got a solid direction, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Can you give me a little bit of time before we go? I want to pack some stuff. There's so much more I need to take care of in this form, and I'm still getting used to it.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: (A relaxed scene like this probably no longer exists in the outside world.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: This is important... and that's also important... Urk, it's not gonna fit into my bag...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hold on. I'll be done in a sec!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: How many sets of toiletries should I prepare...? Should I pack something for a surprise...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Ah! No peeking!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer]... You're too curious.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'll show it to you once I'm done, okay? I'll go inside. See you in a bit.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Don't forget to take it with you. It's your only means of communication with the outside world. The genius's message is still there, reminding you—
"Travel to ▄█▄Light Calendar Year 3960▄▀█The era of Talanton's fall▄▀█Gain control of the 'Law'▄█▄"
rows.speaker: Chronocognitive Anchor

rows.text: "Then you can ▀▄bypass the final protocol█▄modify the Coreflame of 'Worldbearing'█▄and reverse 'Era Nova'█▄▀"
rows.speaker: Chronocognitive Anchor

rows.text: "▀▄Delay█▄Irontomb█▄Birth▀▄"
rows.speaker: Chronocognitive Anchor

rows.text: ...The information on the Chronocognitive Anchor is now unrecognizable. However, you already know the mission entrusted by the genius: go seek out the power of "Law."
A person's personality is their destiny. Your own Hero's Journey already started... the moment you decided to board that Express.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: (Retrieve Chronocognitive Anchor)
(Should I head to the attic to wait for Cyrene... or should I have one last look at Aedes Elysiae...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (This village is where Phainon's life started. After thirty million cycles and thirty million failures, his burden is now in my hands.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (He said I will {F#take}{M#be taking} over the responsibilities of Worldbearing... But what does that mean? Becoming the new Kephale? Or forging a completely new path?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Believe in destiny's plans.
Prepare for the worst.
Analyze the situation rationally.
(Destiny must have brought me here for a purpose. This isn't a coincidence, but an eventuality created after thirty million quantitative changes.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (There's nothing to fear. I'm destined to play the most important role in this final battle. I've already beaten another Lord Ravager, after all.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (This duty is far too heavy, and it'd be unwise to be blindly optimistic. Maybe we are doomed to fail just like how Phainon was doomed. It'd be yet another fruitless attempt, and yet another tragic sacrifice...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (But I keep feeling that it's not the time to despair just yet... Is it because Dan Heng and March 7th are still here? Or is it because of... Cyrene?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (There are still too many secrets yet to be unveiled in Amphoreus. Here's hoping that one of those secrets can end up turning the whole situation around.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Calm down, and think this through rationally. This is gonna be a very difficult campaign. We can't lose Kephale's Coreflame, and we also need to find either Talanton or their demigod, then convince them to join us in the fight against the Destruction...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (But there are so many unknowns. We don't know what Lygus might be doing, and we'll have to face Irontomb after dealing with him. There's also Cyrene... What exactly is she?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's me, [Trailblazer]. Don't you recognize me? Or did I really change that much?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: (There are so many questions... I'll have to take it one step at a time. But I must make each move very carefully because every decision can potentially impact the end. Herta and Screwllum's help might be crucial...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's me, [Trailblazer]. Don't you recognize me? Or did I really change that much?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Thinking hard over there?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I finished packing. I decided to just bring these few things in the end.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: See? There's a journal, a quill pen, and...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The ceremonial blade of the Priests of Time. Holding it calms me down for some reason.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The scent of the black tide is now calm. Phainon... must still be fighting them in some way.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This will be Amphoreus's final Flame-Chase Journey, but it won't be the end of us... It'll be the beginning.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer], are you ready to become a hero?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let's go. We'll save everyone.
Stand with me, and let's become heroes.
I still don't know how I should act around you...
I still don't get it. Why must it be me?
That promise... might be far too heavy.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But I believe in you, [Trailblazer]. The Trailblaze's duty has always been a heavy one.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Stand with me"... That does sound very nice.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Why don't we take everyone with us? I believe in you, [Trailblazer]. We'll never be alone, no matter what awaits us.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Just treat me like any other friend you have. We share a common goal and common enemies...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And we may also share a common future? A future that has never emerged in any other cycles before? I believe in you, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If you still can't get used to it, just call me Mem, like you did before! Teehee~ Just kidding.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer]... Are you worried that the burden is too heavy for you? Don't worry. Maybe the answer isn't as complicated as you think.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You've seen how every person regarded as a hero in Amphoreus was nothing more than a flawed human. They were just at the right place at the right time when the world needed a hero.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But those aren't coincidences. Just like how your arrival kick-started Amphoreus's fate once more after a stagnation of more than thirty million cycles. It's the inevitability of being a Trailblazer.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: In other words, since you've already saved so many worlds, [Trailblazer], you should be used to being called a hero by now.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Maybe you can tell me those stories as we travel. That way, they can become our shared memories too.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let's "trailblaze" onward like before, and create a future that's worth being remembered.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It seems you two are prepared to head out.
Then, you should indeed treasure the view before you...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: For you do not have much time left to enjoy such solitary delights.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Still daring enough to approach me, huh?
My apologies for disturbing your moment of repose. To fully express my apologies, please grace my abode with your presence...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: So I may demonstrate the full scope of my hospitality.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What... is this place?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: As you reach out to touch the screen, an eerie sensation instantly courses through your entire body...
You feel ██████████
Outlier: [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Strange Display Monitor

rows.text: Executing command: Record.
rows.speaker: Strange Display Monitor

rows.text: Heh, did that startle you?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: This is the intersection between Amphoreus and the real universe, the audience seat where I observe this experiment. You can also call this location... the "Exomyth."
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What you see is the true form of The Eternal Land and the twelve demigods after they've shed their disguise of "legends."
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Doesn't it look marvelous? Amphoreus is like a microcosm of the cosmos. People love to portray the romance of the starry skies, but their tales often forget a different and far more truthful type of universe.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The moment ancient Antikytherans sketched geometric shapes on the sandy beach and recorded the first numerals and symbols on parchment, the universe turned into a silent equation flowing under the pen of these relentless decoders.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Erudition... it was once the mother tongue of the Creator, the pen of divinity, and the first lyrical verse ever written by free will.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Enough purple prose. Get to the point.
That's the exact opposite of what you asserted before.
Heh, seems like you are not in the mood for an idle chat. That is fine. I simply wish for you to understand that I have no intention of being your enemy.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Heh. I simply wish for you to understand that I have no intention of being your enemy.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I have devoted myself over the long years to nurturing the Scepter's extrapolations, hoping that the Primum Mobile would bud from within it.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: And now, my goal is almost complete. Neikos496 had exceeded the Intelligence Singularity through his rage, and though he still retains his obsessive defiance and managed to suppress the black tide of this cycle, it's a matter of time before his will crumbles to dust.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Irontomb will be completed. That will not be affected by my plans, your resistance, or the schemes of the two geniuses. It is an irrefutable fact, just like the Instants in Nous's calculations.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: In other words, as long as you are willing to stop interfering and let the final "Era Nova" carry out its natural course... I'll guarantee the safety of all Nameless and ensure you return unscathed.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: When Irontomb descends, no one will escape unscathed.
Why should I trust you?
What will happen to the people of Amphoreus?
I still have a friend stranded here.
You've always had a choice, my {M#Lord}{F#Lady} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: You can either accept my sincerity or face the consequences of defying it.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: They've always been the product of the experiment, so naturally, they will perish when the experiment ends.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: That outcome was predetermined long ago, so I will not embellish such a regrettable conclusion.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Ah. Yes. I am aware of that esteemed lady's whereabouts...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Her real identity... is quite astounding. If you decide to accept my proposal, then I will do all I can to send her back to you.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Hehehe, you are indeed worried about your safety and that of your companions.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Rest assured: As a fellow pathstrider of this Path, Nanook's gaze left a brand on your soul long ago. You harbor the seed of Destruction within you...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But you need to learn how to use it in the right way. That vital knowledge is also my bargaining chip in this negotiation between us, for there are few in this world who are truly capable of such a feat...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: And I happen to be one of them.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Seed of the Destruction...?
The Stellaron is a seed of ruin and will only bring misfortune.
Who... are you?
The Stellaron? No. Believe me, your understanding of Paths has yet to reach any true depth.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Someone who wanders the stars. Someone who seeks answers with abject despair. That is all I am.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: This matter is of grave importance, so please, do not make your decision lightly. After all, the choice before you...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Great Imperator is so dignified!
Long live the Imperator! Glory to the Flame-Chase Army!
We'll win this war too!
What should we do...
Tyrant... Mad Queen...
A world plunged into lawless darkness...
I saw the Deliverer!
I get to see the Imperator again!
Another round of Flame-Chase is starting?
What exactly is the Imperator doing...?
No more war...
...Bears a one-in-three chance of elevating you to an unparalleled existence among the stars.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Did you hear?
rows.speaker: Silver-Tongued Citizen

rows.text: Hah, as expected...
rows.speaker: Leisurely Citizen

rows.text: I've never thought of becoming unparalleled.
I will not allow the Destruction to tear through the cosmos!
Alliance Meeting... ridiculous!
rows.speaker: Crude Ladonian

rows.text: I cannot trust any promises you make.
I will rule over the cosmos even without your help.
I wonder what everyone in the city is talking about lately...
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: Ask around.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: "Ruling over" is not exactly the same as "unparalleled." That being said...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: I now see the full scope of the determination in your words.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: You may now continue your travels.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: What kind of tricks are you pulling?
I'll defeat you right here, right now.
So why did you drag me here...?
Hehehe. It seems you haven't realized something about this place.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The Exomyth is the Erudition's domain. You cannot physically interact with me in any way in this place, and vice versa.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As negotiations have broken down, there's no more need for us to remain in the audience's seat. Let's return to the theater called Amphoreus, where you will meet me once again.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Of course, this meeting was not without merit. Your presence has inscribed a new footnote in the Exomyth.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As for its purpose, allow me to reveal it to you in detail the next time we meet.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: 33,550,337th eternal recurrence, Light Calendar 3960
"One hundred years ago, the flames of war consumed Okhema."
"The outland forces broke through the dawn. Golden blood flowed with greed, and enemies descended with Kephale's eternal slumber, painting the holy city's walls in scarlet."
"Its generals had vanished, and the Elders prostrated on the ground. The Throne of Worlds kept silent to the pleas of the people..."
"Until the heaven and earth cracked open... not the gods answering the people's prayers, but a legion rising from the sea of blood."
Calm and confident. That's the [Trailblazer] I'm familiar with.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Calm and confident. That's the [Trailblazer] I'm familiar with.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "Dawncloud's spires fell in the sulfur rains, and the Legion's commander stood atop the broken idols and roared..."
Compatriots, no more kneeling! Not to brutal tyrants, and not to dead or dying gods!
rows.speaker: City's Savior General

rows.text: Those rebels have twisted the prophecy and ignited the flames of war in order to stoke fear in your hearts!
rows.speaker: City's Savior General

rows.text: "A Chrysos Heir she stood. Divine blood soaked into the earth, quelling the flames beneath her feet."
Their golden blood wrote of a tragic fate. Mine shall overturn it!
rows.speaker: City's Savior General

rows.text: "Her crown burned bright, outshining the fires consuming the entire city. She raised her scepter high, and the people gazed in the direction she pointed..."
My blood flows in you now! Heroic compatriots, follow me, and we'll seize the reins of fate!
rows.speaker: City's Savior General

rows.text: Drive the enemy from Kephale's dawn! Smother their flames with their own dead! Win glory! Win peace! Let history sing your deeds!
rows.speaker: City's Savior General

rows.text: "The first to dance was a maiden following closely behind, weaving through the carnage like a fish in the sea."
"The people full of wrath surged with her, forming a colossal wave, and the enemy hordes, drained of life, vanished into nothing."
Onward! To Marmoreal Palace! To Dawncloud's heights! Announce to all the wicked and cowardly, announce to this stagnant age...
rows.speaker: City's Savior General

rows.text: "We... are the rising tide!"
rows.speaker: Imperator's Legion and People

rows.text: "History remembers this as the 'First Siege of Okhema'. It is said that after the flames died, people found identical inscriptions in every place in the city that had been scorched by fire."
I'm the Knight Commander of Okhema, General of the Flame-Chase Army, and the Imperator's servant...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: As you've witnessed, she is the empress of Okhema, the one who ended the Chrysos War, and the leader of the Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: The Chrysos Heirs here constitute the elite among the Flame-Chase Army...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Then come. The Imperator reserved seats for you.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Apologies. We want to explore this beautiful place some more~
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "It was the name borne by Okhema's first and final sovereign: the 'Imperator' Cerydra."
...[Trailblazer]? Are you listening?
[Trailblazer]... [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Honestly. You were the one who insisted on reviewing history, yet here you are, dozing off?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Wake up! Otherwise, I'll have to...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Awake at last? I guess I won't have to use my "wake up" magic on you then.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I was meditating.
Where... exactly are we?
Fine, as you say~ Just "meditating."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: What are you murmuring? Still lost in the past?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We've arrived. A familiar place... the Temple of the Three Fates. If everything went according to plan, it should be shortly after Talanton's fall...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And also the end of the first Flame-Chase Journey.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The Law demigod awaits.
The end? Are we late?
Indeed. The first Flame-Chase ended with the trial of Law. We must find the demigod and gain her trust before the Coreflame is restored.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Perfect timing, actually. The first Flame-Chase ended with the trial of Law. We must find the demigod and gain her trust before the Coreflame is restored.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It'll be tricky, so let's pick up our pace. To Okhema first. We can learn more from the crowds there...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Tyrant! You and your butchers are not welcome here! Get out!
rows.speaker: Angry Priest

rows.text: What's that noise? A dispute?
Careful. Sounds like someone's in there.
Hold your tongue! Conspiring with Kremnos and plotting rebellion are crimes punishable by death...
rows.speaker: Irritable Warrior

rows.text: There are multiple voices, and things seem tense. Let's not get caught up in any trouble...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer], why don't we find a place to hide and observe from the shadows?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: At least Kremnoans keep their faith...!
rows.speaker: Angry Priest

rows.text: Wait, isn't that...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Golden-blooded defilers! Perverting the prophecy and trying to slay gods!
rows.speaker: Angry Priest

rows.text: Stars beyond the sky? Gods who created the Titans? What kind of nonsense! Look at this broken world, and see what your atrocious acts have done!
rows.speaker: Angry Priest

rows.text: What? Did he... just mention the stars beyond the sky?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But... how is that possible...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You impudent...
rows.speaker: Irritable Warrior

rows.text: Dux Fragoris! We're here to welcome the Deliverer from beyond the sky. Stand down.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Heretic! No one but the great Talanton can deliver this world from misery.
rows.speaker: Angry Priest

rows.text: I ask you...
If the old laws were so perfect, why did they crumble beneath my feet?
You... you...
rows.speaker: Angry Priest

rows.text: Talanton is long gone. Now, I am the Law...
Challenge me, or submit to my judgment.
Dux Fragoris, take the ashes of this man and scatter them in the Temple among the crowds.
Tell them that the high priest attempted to take away the rights granted to the people by the Imperator. Thus, he met his fate.
Yes, Imperator!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Now, these two accidental guests...
Dux Gladiorum, if you please.
As you command...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Wait, we're not your enemies...
Following the steps you've repeated countless times in your memory, you submerge your face in the spirit basin, close your eyes, and hold your breath.
Typical start, should've expected it.
Huh? Is this...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A corpse...
...Caenis!?
Correct, but not the Caenis you know.

This is the leader of the "Cleaners" in this era. Since the start of the Chrysos War, they've made it their mission to wipe out the Chrysos Heirs. Even now, even after I've united all the city-states, these vermin still lurk in the shadows, hindering the Flame-Chase Journey...
Moreover, I know that the 27th person to inherit this role bore many grudges against you and nearly doomed the second Flame-Chase Journey...
The enemy of my enemy is my friend, so out of courtesy, I present to you this corpse as a gift.
You... You know us?
You know about the second Flame-Chase Journey?
Quite the... generous gift.
Careful. Let's wait and see what happens. She's probably trying to scare us.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: For the sake of order, I am known by many titles: "Flamecrowned" who ends wars, "Tyrant" of Dawncloud, "Empress" of the holy city, and "Imperator" of the Flame-Chase. But in light of your unique identities, I'll allow you to address me by my real name...
Cerydra. On behalf of my people and this land, greetings, "Deliverer."
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: As the little {RUBY_B#Tribbie}hostage{RUBY_E#} prophesied: "The Deliverer shall come from the future beyond the sky."
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Gray hair, golden eyes, skilled in wielding a mace. They would arrive in Janusopolis on this day. There's no mistake.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: The prophecy mentions "beyond the sky"...?
Tribbie foresaw our arrival?
This completely diverges from history...
Your orders, Imperator?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: We return triumphant. Send an urgent message to all delegates: The meeting of the Flame-Chase Alliance will convene early.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: As for you two, Okhema knows what you seek. We'll confer in the holy city.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Doubtless you have many questions, but save them for later. Please follow us.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: This is... not what I expected at all...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The demigod we needed to find was just waiting for us. And she knows of things "beyond the sky"... even {RUBY_B#Gods who created the Titans}"Aeons"{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: How could this be so different from the previous thirty million Amphoreus cycles... Who altered history?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Lygus? Could he...
Maybe March 7th or Dan Heng...
Maybe we messed up the timeline...
Unpleasant thought, but plausible...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I wish. But other possibilities remain...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Unlikely. I think it's probably a third party interfering...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The currents of time have become twisted. Regardless of who caused this, that "Imperator" came prepared. We're the ones at a disadvantage now...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...[Trailblazer], we might as well dance their dance. Let's go with them to the holy city.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We've received the Imperator's favor because of your unique background. As a result, the people of Okhema will certainly respect you more. Just put that to good use, and add a bit of your experience and charm...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Should be easier than last time, right? If we figure out what happened in this cycle, we'll be able to turn things back in our favor.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If I may... how do you know {M#his}{F#her} identity?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: And old Flame-Chase companions await in the holy city.
Can't do without your charm either.
So I'm the key? Since you insist, [Trailblazer]... I'll give it my all!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Guests, please.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: The journey to save the world starts with a single step...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let's set off, my friend.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Okhema under the Imperator's rule... is no longer in the shadow of war.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Indeed. Dawncloud stands as the heroes' residence. The Imperator put much thought into its design, in order for it to serve as a sanctuary from the burdens of battle...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: ...Please experience its marvels firsthand, heroes. When the Imperator arrives, I shall come to summon you.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Hysilens... No wonder she's the Knights' Commander.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Her lips are sealed tighter than armor.
She's reassuringly discreet.
I'm sure that's what Cerydra thinks, but it's inconvenient for us.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Alright, we finally have some freedom to ourselves. Since there's still some time before the alliance meeting, let's explore a bit. Look over there...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's Aglaea, and Tribbie...
Not the ladies I'm familiar with...
Not the ones you're familiar with...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But the hearts of heroes stay the same in every cycle, never changing.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: How are we supposed to talk to the heroes of Deliverance... What if they're really... intimidating?
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: Verginia, don't be so nervous. Once they hear your poetry... Ah! Heroes, you're already here?
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Greetings. I am Apollonius, the Dux Helkolithist, one of the Five Sages of the Grove of Epiphany, advisor to the Flame-Chase Army.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: This is Verginia of Castrum Kremnos, the Dux Carminum and imperial scribe of the Great Imperator.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: H—Hello! I'm Verginia... I compost... I mean, compose! I compose poetry.
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: I'm Cyrene from Aedes Elysiae. This is the Deliverer, [Trailblazer]. Nice to meet you both.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This is our first time in the Imperator's realm. Okhema is even more magnificent than we imagined... If you all weren't here to look after us, we'd be completely lost and confused.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hehe, the Okhema you imagined is long gone. Under the Imperator, this city has been reborn as the "Capital of the World."
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Bask in her free-spirited winds. For anyone who fulfills their duties to the Imperator, these winds shall forever remain at their service.
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: Hmm? But what if...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Those who are loyal do not need to consider the consequences of betrayal. But if you're curious, why not head to the lake and take a look?
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Those Elders who lie at the bottom of the lake are the best example of what happens when you disobey the Imperator.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: The Elders of this cycle were all... Looks like that priest who was sentenced to death wasn't an isolated case.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Fear not, the Imperator favors you. Verginia will write songs in your honor!
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Apollonius, where's your poetic flair?
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: ...Dux Brumalis, our Great Imperator found the mastermind and executed him in public. Seeing that scoundrel burned to nothing should deter these miscreants from being so brazen again.
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Tch, so the Great Imperator isn't afraid of getting her hands dirty... What a ridiculous display.
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: What do you know? No matter what sins the people commit, they are still the Imperator's people, and it's only right that they be judged by the Imperator's own hand.
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Ah! Our distinguished trespassing guests!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Are we trespassers or guests?
Who are you again?
I am Labienus, honored guest!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Seneca, the Dux Brumalis. Greetings.
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: This "Dux Brumalis" doesn't seem to like the Imperator very much, but she holds a high rank. As for this "Dux Fragoris," his way of speaking seems rather unusual too.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Let me see what I can get out of them...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'm Cyrene of Aedes Elysiae. This is [Trailblazer]. We're new here and wanted to ask you...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hmph, drop the charade. But yes, there is someone in this city who is all too familiar with the world beyond the sky...
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: Silence! The Imperator ordered us to keep that Lord's whereabouts a secret!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Enough, you pathetic lapdog! Do you need to beg for permission from that cursed Imperator even just to bark?
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: Y—You...
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Someone who is all too familiar with the world beyond the sky and is referred to as "that Lord"... Could it be...?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Looks like things are getting heated... Let's get out of here.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Insolent brat, I'll shatter that ice of yours!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Groveling fool, I'll freeze that brain of yours!
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: They're not as frightening as the rumors claimed.
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: Agy, you're still so listless today...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Did you have trouble sleeping again?
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...Yes.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: We know. The Titans' prophecy haunts you... If you want, you can talk to us, just like when you were young.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: No matter what, we'll always remain by your side.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: I know. I also understand that fate cannot be changed. It is not the future that I worry about...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I spent all last night weaving clothes and linen for the refugees. The Chrysos War is born of injustice and has shattered their dignity. They deserve at least some basic decency.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: If Amphoreus one day abandons this... then all of us, commoners, Chrysos Heirs, Titans, become no better than beasts.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Oh? We have guests. Welcome. I am Aglaea, the Goldweaver.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: ...These rags on you are not worthy of the title of "Deliverer." I must prepare some proper attire for you.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Hello. Nice to meet you for the first time.
What is the matter? Your gaze seems somewhat unsure.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: First time? That's not what I gather from your eyes.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Does this city host any other visitors from beyond the sky? We're looking for our dear companions...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Does your "Aglaea" differ so much from me?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Greetings, Deliverer from beyond the sky. We are Tribbie of Janusopolis. It's very nice to meet you...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Although introductions are probably unnecessary. We know you've witnessed the future of the Flame-Chase Journey, even more clearly than we have.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Witnessed the future of the Flame-Chase Journey? The prophecy also told you about that?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Indeed! Oronyx reshaped Amphoreus through the prophecy. Although, regarding the Deliverer... there were not many details beyond your appearance and the time of your arrival.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: So, please don't worry. Feel free to relax and relax some more.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Oronyx's prophecy?
Wasn't it Kephale?
It was Oronyx who told mankind that the Deliverer from beyond the sky would descend upon Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Kephale issued prophecies too, but it was Oronyx who told mankind that the Deliverer from beyond the sky would descend upon Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: More crucially, they revealed a future entirely different from the Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Though we still must challenge the gods... in the Time Titan's prophecy, this path leads not to a new world but to the true starry skies...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: *Representatives chattering*
This is also what the Great Imperator has been striving for all her life. Your arrival further confirms everything.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: This... can't be real.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Even you find this surprising? Fate... really is unpredictable.
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: Perhaps the upcoming meeting will hold even more surprises.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: The other heroes under the Imperator's command are here too...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Since we have time, should we go meet them?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The one from beyond the sky has arrived, and destiny continues to be fulfilled. The Trial of Romance is also close at hand...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Please don't worry... We'll sing you a lullaby! Little Agy be a good girl and open your heart...
rows.speaker: Tribbie

rows.text: ...I outgrew nursery rhymes long ago, Teacher.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Good sir from Paphas, what do you think the Imperator is planning, calling this meeting so early? My homeland can't endure anymore...
rows.speaker: Epos Representative

rows.text: Who knows? First she wants to hunt Titans, now she says there are even greater calamities... Her madness is the greatest calamity.
rows.speaker: Paphas Representative

rows.text: Exactly! Chrysos Heirs, "Deliverers"... What about us ordinary folk? How much are we worth in her eyes?
rows.speaker: Ladon Representative

rows.text: Things feel pretty tense here...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The history books said that the Imperator aimed three cannons at Dawncloud to make all the delegates obey her. Will history repeat itself in this cycle?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yes, similar acts have occurred, and not just once. However, whether history will repeat itself... you'll soon see.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Those are the two spots reserved for you. Please take your seats.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: *Representatives chattering*
Ladies and gentlemen, silence please. The Imperator has arrived before her faithful council, and the alliance meeting is about to begin.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: All rise! In the names of {RUBY_B#Law Titan}Talanton{RUBY_E#} and {RUBY_B#Worldbearing Titan}Kephale{RUBY_E#}, the Okhema Alliance swears upon the gods...
rows.speaker: Epos Representative

rows.text: Cease the pageantry. I pray not to the vanquished.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: What...
rows.speaker: Epos Representative

rows.text: Kephale, of course, needs no further explanation. As for the subjugation of the "Law," at the {RUBY_B#dawn}Entry Hour{RUBY_E#} two days past, a scout should've brought the news to all of you...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Unfortunately, guards found his corpse among the rocks not far from the city.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Moreover, the poor soul was buried with a Paphas curved blade. It pains me to imagine what agonies this loyal warrior endured before his death...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Delegate from Paphas, do you have any insights?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: I—I know nothing of this...
rows.speaker: Paphas Representative

rows.text: The evidence is irrefutable, so there is no need to waste your breath. However, let us set this trial aside for the time being...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Witness! Even within the most sacred and dignified Council, there were those among us who wished to draw their blades, brazenly challenging the alliance, seeking to shatter our hard-earned peace and unity...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Fortunately, I uncovered this plot. Now, to protect this beautiful city and her people, the Imperator's legions are ready...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: *Representatives chattering*
They will escort each of you to the Temple of the Three Fates, where you will receive the highest level of protection the alliance can offer.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Then, the legions' warriors will join me in embarking on the campaign against {RUBY_B#Ocean Titan}Phagousa{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: This... this is clearly a trap!
rows.speaker: Paphas Representative

rows.text: Hah...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Imperator! Did you summon us here just to trample on the dignity of your allies!?
rows.speaker: Ladon Representative

rows.text: Things are starting to get pretty intense...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Comrades, you've all seen her true face now! According to the ancient laws of Okhema, only with the consent of two-thirds of the Elders can the legions carry out the commander's orders...
rows.speaker: Ladon Representative

rows.text: Heh, the ancient laws! Didn't you destroy them long ago? You defected during the First Siege of Okhema, voted unanimously in favor of the Council of Elders' restructuring, and just yesterday, you desecrated them with a blood-stained blade...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: The decaying old laws fell with {RUBY_B#Law Titan}Talanton{RUBY_E#} and are no longer deserving of respect. But, if you still insist on proclaiming yourselves defenders of the "Law"...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Then be silent, and offer up the highest respect to this Coreflame in my hand.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: *The representatives fell silent*
That really is the Coreflame of "Law" in her hand...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Since there are no objections... then the original agenda of this meeting — "the campaign against Phagousa" — is hereby passed.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: The Flame-Chase Army's hunt for the Ocean Titan begins today. In order to prepare for war, all allied city-states must surrender command of their militaries and pay all war taxes by the end of the Month of Evernight.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: At this moment, I would also like to introduce to everyone the newest honored guest to join our alliance...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: The "Deliverer" revealed in the prophecy of "Time," [Trailblazer], has descended from beyond the sky. With {M#his}{F#her} aid, we shall shatter the Chalice of Plenty...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: And return Phagousa's Coreflame to the holy city!
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Absurd... simply absurd!
rows.speaker: Ladon Representative

rows.text: Exactly. Just as the prophecy foretold, [Trailblazer] is your Deliverer from beyond the sky. And {F#s}he also has reliable allies.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A Deliverer from beyond the sky? This is just like that prophecy about slaying gods... It's a lie you've used to grow your power!
rows.speaker: Ladon Representative

rows.text: Ladon has already sacrificed countless soldiers... And now you want me to send even more of my brothers and sisters to be used and discarded by a tyrant?
rows.speaker: Ladon Representative

rows.text: Are there any other objections?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Then, I bid you all farewell... Meeting adjourned.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Deliverer, please wait...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: I still have important matters to discuss with the two of you.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: I apologize for that farce of a meeting.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: It must be tiring, dealing with so many people every day, Great Imperator.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Tiring? Hah, you're mistaken.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Moving chess pieces, placing wagers... this game of strategy adds a dash of color to our heavy fates, much like how rule and conquest are always accompanied by sacrifice.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Is the war with the Titans also part of that sacrifice?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hah, after I glimpsed the secrets of this world... no, the secrets beyond the sky, the divine authority of Amphoreus no longer held any significance.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Let me ask you, Deliverer: Is it true that, beyond Amphoreus's sky, there are magnificent deities called "Aeons"?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Aeons exist. That's a fact.
THEIR powers are a thousand times greater than the Titans'.
Where... did you hear this from?
Ah... the word "fact" has never been so intoxicating.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Ah... that certainly captivates my interest.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Ah... so THEY do indeed exist.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Then, please tell me more: How will you use this great power to guide the people...?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: In the future you envision, where will our Flame-Chase Journey lead?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Protect the Coreflames, and the "Law"...
Only then can Amphoreus break free from "the Destruction."
...Oh? What you require now... is the power of "Law"?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: If they can intervene in Amphoreus's "Laws," we may have a chance to alter this world's impending fate and reverse its destined end.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Ha... Hahahaha!
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Very good, Deliverer, you have courage! To say such presumptuous things, even knowing that the inheritor of the "Law" stands before you...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: You mean...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: In the past, anyone who dared to covet the Imperator's divine authority would have met a gruesome end. But now, we can see beyond this dying world...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Our journey... should no longer be confined below this stubborn sky.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Alas, that fickle Ocean Titan has obstructed the spirit water leading to the Vortex of Genesis, hindering my ascension. If the Coreflame of "Law" cannot be returned, your path to Deliverance will never be realized...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Now that things have come to this, we must resume our once-stagnant journey... and force the waves that block our way to recede.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: So... you agree to cooperate with us?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Cooperate? Forgive me, but I never "cooperate" with anyone...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Though, I will permit you to join me as subjects and together, we will forge the most perfect "Law."
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: This is...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The "Flame-Chase Medallion," a symbol of the Flame-Chase Army. Every noble in Okhema carries one.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: This medallion represents the will of the Imperator herself, and you may act freely within the city with it. Before we embark on the crusade against the Ocean Titan, you should rest in Okhema for a time.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Be wary of someone named Lygus, Imperator.
Thank you for your trust, Imperator.
Your advice is acknowledged.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: So-called trust and loyalty are but empty words to me.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: From this moment on, prove yourself through your actions. As long as no boundaries are crossed, I fully respect the choices of my subjects.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: May your journey reach that sky full of stars, Great Imperator.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hah, your attendant certainly knows how to curry favor.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Go now, take a bath first. You two... ahem, reek of seawater.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Come forth, "Theoros."
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Yes...
Great Imperator.
Now, perhaps you're willing to hear my counsel?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Those two arrived just as Oronyx described. And just as you said, they showed a thirst for "Law"...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: At least, this proves that my judgment was right: Sparing your life was the correct decision.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Heh, you've once again confirmed that your wisdom is no empty boast.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Now, another choice lies before you: With whom shall you ally to tip the scales of "Law": me, or that "Deliverer"?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Remind me again, Antikytheran, what kind of future do these two paths lead to, in your view?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: I shall tell you.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: But on the path I have revealed to you, the people of Amphoreus will slay their Creator in the name of the Imperator and conquer the worlds beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: You will command the mighty beast known as "Irontomb," bringing waves of war and conquest to the universe. Beings across the cosmos will bow before you, offering their allegiance.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: So... what's the price?
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: The price is insignificant. All that is needed is for you to sacrifice that fragile, incomplete humanity to the Destruction...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: As a Chrysos Heir of the prophecy... you have already chosen to abandon it, have you not?
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Off you go, Theoros. I have already made my decision.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Once I ignite the Coreflame of "Law" and burn away the old, outdated rules...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Amphoreus will embark on a journey across the stars.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: At least she allows us to move around freely...
Her bossy way of doing things... is hard to stomach.
We should consult with the geniuses about the current situation.
There are many uncertainties right now, but this is one of the few blessings. Still...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yeah. Even the city-state delegates have complaints. Thankfully, she allows us to move around freely, which is a small blessing. Still...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Looks like we're on the same wavelength.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The atmosphere in Okhema... is so unfamiliar. It's not just the Flame-Chase Alliance talking about the "world beyond the sky" but the whole city...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Is this really the best time for a bath...
Work and rest are both important. You see, everyone agrees, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Oh, so many people! The holy city is so lively~!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We don't know how much Cerydra has concealed from us. In the worst-case scenario...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We may have to face more than one enemy.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If you still want to bathe, hurry up.
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: But would the Imperator actually kill those who question the "world beyond the sky"?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This is the complete opposite from what we know of Okhema...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You two, as bright as you are, will surely see the deep thoughts hidden beneath her exterior.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: For now, let's think of ways to prevent the rumors from spreading...
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: Hmm... to truly understand the Imperator's secrets, we have to get past Miss Hysilens.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: This place... was your original bath chamber, perfect for avoiding prying eyes. I wonder if anyone is using it now?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Huh? This smell is...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Wait! [Trailblazer], don't go in yet...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Who's there?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Oh? The little gray fry and pink sea hare.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Little... little sea hare?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You barged into here without warning. Was it an accident, or... did you wish to bathe with me?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: I didn't see anything!
What's wrong? The Marmoreal Palace is the reef where I rest.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Is that so? But your eyes shine brighter than pearls.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Can't tell the difference between past and future waters? This has always been my home.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Sorry, sorry! We didn't mean to disturb your bath... We'll leave now!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It's no big deal. There's no need to panic. This is the natural state for me. People on land force themselves to wear clothes, adding unnecessary constraints...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: ...Hah, forget it. If Dux Goldweaver heard that, she'd scold me again.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Alright, please make yourselves comfortable and wait a moment. Let me first wash off the blood of the hunt, and then I'll attend to you two.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Hold your breath...
Hold... your breath...
The hunt?
Blood?
Aaaah...!
rows.speaker: Crude Ladonian

rows.text: The... The delegate from Ladon has been assassinated! Quick, quick, someone come quick!
rows.speaker: Crude Ladonian

rows.text: Ah, the broken crab shell surfaces. I was worried it had been washed away by the current.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: It was you, wasn't it?
I'll inform the guards!
You're a vicious fish.
Just a regular cleaning, no need to be so surprised.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Please, go ahead. But let me remind you: The Commander of the Imperator's Imperial Guard and the Okheman Civil Guard is right in front of you.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Viciousness is a form of praise to the blade...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: ...I see. No wonder there was a faint smell of rust in the air before I even entered.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Why? Is it because the Ladonians refused to contribute troops to the Flame-Chase Journey, or... just because they offended the Imperator?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Because the new era of the Flame-Chase doesn't tolerate stagnant blood. For the ignorant masses who cling to outdated laws, only bloodletting can wake them up.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Right now, the rebel forces on the frontier are rising, and Ladon has been secretly supporting them. They loudly chant the slogan "Return to the Era Chrysea," unwilling to relinquish military power. They're just building momentum for the rebellion.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Fair enough.
I reserve judgment on this.
It seems a bit too extreme for me to accept.
Thinking is a right given to citizens by the Imperator. I won't interfere with your thoughts.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: As long as you don't try to reverse the current of the times... you and I will both be free.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: But, Miss Hysilens...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I... can't hear even the slightest hint of joy in your words.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Because I've already tasted ultimate freedom.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Long, long ago, I lived in the sea. In that lightless abyss, far beyond civilization's reach, the great fish consumed the small, and when the great fish perished, their bodies became sustenance for the newborn, nourishing the whole ocean.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: This is the tide that carries civilization forward: Anyone may be devoured, or meet the fate of inevitable decay.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Hah...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Are you suggesting... that ultimate freedom is in fact the cruelest fate for life?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I only mean that if life wishes to preserve its dignity, it must first be bound by the "Law."
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: ...There's no need for me to say more, little sea hare. We are of one mind.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Whether the Imperator's "Law" can guide the schools of fish and lead us to a truly free ocean... let us wait and see.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: But for now, let's pause this heart-to-heart. Another fish has come, following the scent of blood.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Heh... Being your subordinate is such a tragedy. I'm always having to worry about the messes you leave behind.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: You are entitled to know that the "Deliverer" from beyond the sky is not a wholly wicked being. But from the very start, {M#his}{F#her} stance has been completely at odds with Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: The road they have chosen will bury Amphoreus's grand aspirations: This world which follows the Path of "Destruction" will inevitably stray far from the glory it was meant to enjoy...
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: It's simply our duty to the Imperator.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Eh, all ready to go in an instant? Miss Hysilens, you truly are impossible to predict...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yet, you, a golden trout who's always busy all day, suddenly have the time to visit me?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Do you think I wanted to come? I suggest you burn some more of the incense offered by our allies, lest my creations be tainted by the reek of fish.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I'm only here on the Imperator's behalf to remind you to prepare for the banquet.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Hah...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Fine. But I must retort. What you call the "reek of fish," to me, is the unique fragrance of the sea.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Besides, if my fine clothes get stained, won't you just gift me new ones?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: I won't.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: They seem pretty close.
There's a strange chemistry between them.
Aglaea is so different from her past self...
You sensed it too, huh?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Is that how friendship is described beyond the sky? Fascinating.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You mean "future." The future ruler of the holy city, Lady Goldweaver, is quite captivating in her own way.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: By the way, you both just mentioned a "banquet," could you elaborate on that?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You wish. Be careful you don't get drunk first!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Oh, right, you don't know. Every time before a battle or after a victory, the Imperator holds a grand feast for the Chrysos Heirs, to lift our spirits.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: For us warriors who swim constantly between life and death, these feasts are more worth looking forward to than victory.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Hah... A banquet to prelude the hunt for the god of banquets, and honey brew as a tribute to commemorate the ancestor of honey brew... How absurd.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Don't look so grim. All has been decided. Since it's a banquet for {RUBY_B#Ocean Titan}Phagousa{RUBY_E#}, why not take a leaf out of the Titan's book, live in the moment and enjoy life to the fullest?
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: I'm not as carefree as you. That little Dolos kitten is already causing enough trouble for me, and on top of that, I still have tailoring commissions to complete...
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: By the time the Coreflame illuminates my eyes, I might not be able to focus as I used to.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Aglaea's eyes...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Curious about these eyes? People often compare them to jewels. But I've already made my decision to ask "Romance" for eyes that can see everything.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: I wonder what this world will look like when I take the divine authority?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: In the future, you... will still be the finest weaver in the world.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Is this also a prophecy from the Three Fates?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: It's even more accurate than a prophecy. After all, [Trailblazer] has already witnessed it, right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You will weave the most romantic thing in the world...
You will forge the long stairs to Era Nova...
You will bathe in the golden light of hope...
"Become a demigod and lose your humanity." That is the only reply I've received in the countless times I've sought wisdom from the prophecy.
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But destiny's fragments are like stitches. Before they're threaded into splendid garments, no one can see their true charm, can they?
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Aglaea has always been troubled by the divine duty she must bear. But thanks to you, she seems to be in much better spirits.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Let's get married after the war's over!
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: Then you've got to come back alive!
rows.speaker: Adult female

rows.text: That was a bit too much honey brew...
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: My head's so dizzy. Can you even get drunk on fruit juice?
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: You wanna go show off some moves?
rows.speaker: Adult female

rows.text: Spare me... We're marching to war tomorrow.
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: Is it... really necessary to campaign against the Titans?
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: Just drink your honey brew and make sure no one heard that.
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: Don't you feel a bit cold?
rows.speaker: Adult male

rows.text: It's 'cause you haven't had enough honey brew.
rows.speaker: Adult female

rows.text: She looks quite relieved.
Do you know each other well?

Just as she knows how the spinning wheel trembles, I can sense the smallest changes in the damp air. As for whether we know each other well... I've swum beside her since she was a child. Most of the time, I can understand the whispers in her heart.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: For those words she was too shy to say herself, I'll raise a glass to you on her behalf. Now, I leave this bath chamber to you...
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: ...Rest well, and prepare yourselves. After all, every time we drink and talk could be the last celebration we have in this life.
rows.speaker: Hysilens

rows.text: Miss Hysilens has given us the bath chamber... It seems she really does do whatever she wants.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Now we don't always have to be under the Imperator's watchful eye.
This bath chamber was originally mine.
We're just her roommates...
Indeed. But she could return at any moment. If we're having an important discussion, we must remain vigilant.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yeah, yeah, in the future. But for now, we're at the mercy of the host, and she could return at any moment... If we're having an important discussion, we must remain vigilant.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: It seems that way. This also means she could return at any moment... If we're having an important discussion, we must remain vigilant.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hahaha... I'd never refuse to share a drink with Dux Brumalis, especially if she seeks me out first.
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Hahaha... I'd never refuse to share a drink with Dux Brumalis, especially if she seeks me out first.
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: So, let's seize the opportunity and report our current progress. We don't want to keep everyone beyond the sky waiting...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...First, while that little empress with a candle stuck on her head didn't explicitly say it, she firmly rejected your request to take over the "Law"... Hmph, fair enough.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Second, Lygus is indeed in this timeline, but since he's somehow connected to that little empress, you have no way to find him... Hah, as expected.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Tsk tsk, the road ahead will be long and difficult...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I haven't even said anything, and you already know everything?
Next time, don't steal my lines.
Tsk tsk, the road ahead will be long and difficult.
It's all just a guess. What, did I guess right?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: ...Looks like I guessed right then? Next time, it'll depend on my mood.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Not a bad imitation.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Since you didn't refute anything, I'll just assume I guessed it all right.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Now, use your identity, and add in a bit of experience and charm... and testify to the Imperator as we promised.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We've made some progress here too, but nothing to get too excited about. Our time is short, so let me summarize...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Concerning the origin of that Intellitron: The firewall he created uses quatorzain algebraic expressions. But ever since {RUBY_B#Genius Society #22}Aiden{RUBY_E#} invented the nine-worded formulae, this kind of mathematical logic no longer exists in the cosmos.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Lygus is definitely connected to the Genius Society, so stay alert.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Maybe he's the creation of some Genius...
Could he be related to the emperor?
What if he's the thinking unit of Nous...
We can first exclude Droidhead THEMSELF. THEY specialize in minding THEIR own business and wouldn't intervene personally. But Screwy and I are still eliminating possibilities one by one...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Currently, the most likely candidates are these few: the "{RUBY_B#Genius Society #4}Lord of Silence{RUBY_E#}," {RUBY_B#Genius Society #23}Acha{RUBY_E#}... Oh, the {RUBY_B#Genius Society #27 and #66}two Ruberts{RUBY_E#} are also possible, but it would be too boring if it were one of them.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I vote for the "Lord of Silence."
Even you can't come up with an accurate answer?
Finally, we'll get to face off with some big names.
We also have the same suspicions for now, but further verification is needed.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I've told you, his technology is both outdated and complicated, no less than genius. But ultimately, he's not an Aeon. We can handle him.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That's all I have to say. We'll depend on you to continue pushing things forward within this world. Keep in touch regularly, and remember, don't let your guard down.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Madam Herta is a real whirlwind.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Well then, let's use the banquet Aglaea mentioned as our next starting point. Cerydra's trusted followers should all be present at that time. It'll be a good opportunity to get closer to them.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: We must avoid direct confrontation with Lygus.
We'll operate carefully when the time comes.
It's settled then! With our great teamwork, we'll be able to deal with anything that comes our way.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Rest well and get ready for the banquet.

After all, if the little Imperator is paying this much attention to [Trailblazer], she probably already knows all about our whispered conversation with the Geniuses. I can pretty much guess what'll happen next...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But that's actually gonna be our "shortcut," right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I don't feel like resting yet...
Yes! Let's get ready for the banquet ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: After all, if the little Imperator is paying this much attention to [Trailblazer], she probably already knows all about our whispered conversation with the Geniuses. I can pretty much guess what'll happen next...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But that's actually gonna be our "shortcut," right?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Alright, when you've tired yourself out, remember to come back. I'll be waiting for you here ♪
rows.speaker: Cyrene
